unit_cn: Unit 4 Stage and Screen 舞台与银幕
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 4 词表(p123-124 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、舞台/银幕(戏剧/电影/电视)主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Peking Opera combines music, singing and acting on one stage.
words.example_cn: 京剧把音乐、演唱和表演结合在一个舞台上。

words.example_en: Every movement of the dancers told part of the story.
words.example_cn: 舞者的每个动作都讲述着故事的一部分。

words.example_en: The costumes were the aspect of the opera that impressed me most.
words.example_cn: 戏服是这部歌剧中最令我印象深刻的方面。

words.example_en: This film is a modern version of a classic play.
words.example_cn: 这部电影是一部经典戏剧的现代版本。

words.example_en: The jinghu is a small instrument with only two strings.
words.example_cn: 京胡是一种只有两根弦的小乐器。

words.example_en: Some of the female voices were so high that they amazed me.
words.example_cn: 一些女声高得令我惊叹。

words.example_en: Using simple techniques, the actors turned a bare stage into a palace.
words.example_cn: 运用简单的手法,演员们把空荡的舞台变成了宫殿。

words.example_en: A few clever props can transform an empty stage into a forest.
words.example_cn: 几件巧妙的道具就能把空舞台变成一片森林。

words.example_en: On stage, a single screen seemed to open up a whole universe.
words.example_cn: 在舞台上,仅一块幕布似乎就展开了整个宇宙。

words.example_en: Watching the actor do a backflip on stage was simply incredible.
words.example_cn: 看演员在舞台上后空翻简直令人难以置信。

words.meaning_cn: 精力充沛的;充满活力的
words.example_en: The dance was so energetic that the performers seemed like athletes.
words.example_cn: 这段舞蹈充满活力,演员们看起来像运动员。

words.example_en: Everyone began to clap as the curtain came down.
words.example_cn: 幕布落下时,大家都开始鼓掌。

words.phrase_en: on the edge of one's seat
words.example_en: The exciting story kept us on the edge of our seats.
words.example_cn: 扣人心弦的故事让我们一直坐在座位边缘。

words.example_en: Feeling the strong emotions in the play, I almost cried.
words.example_cn: 感受到剧中强烈的情感,我几乎哭了。

words.example_en: The actor showed the prince's anger with just one look.
words.example_cn: 演员只用一个眼神就表现出王子的愤怒。

words.example_en: The show combines singing, dancing and drama with great effect.
words.example_cn: 这场演出把演唱、舞蹈和戏剧出色地结合在一起。

words.example_en: The opera brings together music, drama and poetry.
words.example_cn: 这部歌剧把音乐、戏剧和诗歌融为一体。

words.example_en: The final scene ended with explosive energy and colour.
words.example_cn: 最后一幕以爆发式的能量和色彩收尾。

words.example_en: The whole audience stood up to applaud the actors.
words.example_cn: 全场观众起立为演员们鼓掌。

words.example_en: Seeing my family in the audience, I felt confident and grateful.
words.example_cn: 看到家人在观众席里,我感到自信又感激。

words.example_en: Before going on stage, I felt extremely nervous.
words.example_cn: 上台之前,我感到极其紧张。

words.example_en: With my teacher's help, I overcame my fears and finished the play.
words.example_cn: 在老师的帮助下,我克服了恐惧,演完了这出戏。

words.example_en: Last night I went to watch the ballet The Peony Pavilion.
words.example_cn: 昨晚我去看了芭蕾舞剧《牡丹亭》。

words.meaning_cn: 专心致志的;全神贯注的
words.example_en: As soon as the curtain rose, I was completely absorbed.
words.example_cn: 幕布一升起,我就完全入了迷。

words.example_en: The dance was full of colour and romantic symbols.
words.example_cn: 这段舞蹈充满色彩与浪漫的象征。

words.example_en: We laughed all evening at the comedy show.
words.example_cn: 在喜剧表演上我们笑了一整晚。

words.example_en: The nature documentary showed leopards in the wild.
words.example_cn: 这部自然纪录片展现了野外的豹子。

words.example_en: Last night's episode was absolutely wonderful.
words.example_cn: 昨晚那一集绝对精彩。

words.example_en: I can't wait to watch the final episode of the talent show.
words.example_cn: 我等不及要看这档选秀节目的最后一集了。

words.example_en: The leopards are such appealing creatures that the show is a joy to watch.
words.example_cn: 豹子是如此惹人喜爱,这部片子看着真令人愉快。

words.example_en: The Monkey King is definitely a hero to many children.
words.example_cn: 对许多孩子来说,孙悟空绝对是个英雄。

words.example_en: I enjoy this film for its creative plot and clever settings.
words.example_cn: 我喜欢这部电影有创意的情节和巧妙的场景。

words.example_en: The talk show host was so rude that he hardly let his guests speak.
words.example_cn: 那个脱口秀主持人太无礼了,几乎不让嘉宾说话。

words.example_en: We took public transport to reach the festival site.
words.example_cn: 我们乘公共交通到达了音乐节场地。

words.example_en: Josh made all the arrangements for our trip to the concert.
words.example_cn: 去演唱会的所有安排都是Josh做的。

words.example_en: Even a brief look at the book shows how much the film left out.
words.example_cn: 即使简单看一眼原著,也能发现电影遗漏了多少内容。

words.example_en: Too often great books are turned into cinematic turkeys.
words.example_cn: 好书常常被拍成电影界的失败之作。

words.example_en: Even the Harry Potter films could not escape from leaving out parts of the story.
words.example_cn: 连《哈利·波特》电影也无法避免遗漏部分故事情节。

words.example_en: Fans of the book were disappointed not to see their favourite characters.
words.example_cn: 原著粉丝因没看到喜爱的角色而失望。

words.example_en: The choice of actress changed opinions of the film to some extent.
words.example_cn: 女演员的人选在某种程度上改变了人们对这部电影的看法。

words.example_en: Perhaps we should judge a film on its own, not against the original book.
words.example_cn: 也许我们该就电影本身来评价它,而不是拿它与原著比较。

words.example_en: In the film, Mia learns she is the princess of a fictional kingdom.
words.example_cn: 在电影里,Mia得知自己是一个虚构王国的公主。

words.meaning_cn: 尴尬的;笨拙的;不舒适的
words.example_en: Mia is a socially awkward girl who suddenly becomes a princess.
words.example_cn: Mia是个不善交际的女孩,却突然成了公主。

words.example_en: She is taught how to behave at royal events.
words.example_cn: 她被教导在王室场合上如何举止得体。

words.example_en: Mia must choose between a normal life and life as a princess.
words.example_cn: Mia必须在平常生活和公主生活之间做出选择。

words.example_en: The film explores the theme of responsibility in a humorous way.
words.example_cn: 这部电影以幽默的方式探讨了责任这一主题。

words.example_en: Courage is not the absence of fear, but doing what is right in spite of it.
words.example_cn: 勇气不是没有恐惧,而是不顾恐惧去做正确的事。

words.example_en: Through the music I could feel the prince's love, anger and grief.
words.example_cn: 透过音乐,我能感受到王子的爱、愤怒与悲痛。
